parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

maxConcurrentComputesAllowedRange.description:
The permitted range for {@link QueuesResourceGovernorConfig#maxConcurrentComputes}
Value of -1 indicates there are no limits.

maxCpu.description: Throttle Queue action dispatching to avoid CPU utilization exceeding this number.

maxFullGcCount.description:
Throttle Queue action by limiting total gc count in the time window specified by
{@link ResourceGovernorConfig#queues}

maxFullGcTimeMillis.description:
Throttle Queue action by limiting total gc time in the time window specified by
{@link ResourceGovernorConfig#queues}

minFreeDatastoreDiskSpacePct.description: Throttle Queue action by limiting minimum free disk space percentage in the range [0, 100] across all storage nodes

maxDatastoreFragmentationPct.description: Throttle Queue action by limiting maximum fragmentation int the range [0, 100] across all storage nodes

maxDatastoreQueuedTaskCount.description: Throttle Queue action by limiting maximum number of queued tasks across all storage nodes

maxConcurrentComputes.description:
Throttle Queue actions by limiting maximum number of queue entries that will be processed concurrently
in a task node

title: Type that defines the threshold for key metrics in queue rules-based Resource Governor
name: QueuesResourceGovernorConfig
